notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Dockside Extortionist.
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Fool's Demise first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Repeat.
